was: 40 unserviced sites in a rustic mountain-valley campground on Island Lake, 14 km W of Coleman in Crowsnest Pass; sites accommodate RVs. First-come, first-served (self-registration, cash/cheque). No potable water. Open May-Oct. Per Alberta Parks. --Claude

was: 16 unserviced sites (mix of FCFS and reservable) on a peninsula above St. Mary Reservoir ~5 km NW of Magrath; most sites have lake views, beach nearby. Open year-round (winter sites FCFS). Non-potable water. Reservable online. Per Alberta Parks. --Claude
